items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: I think, I'm not certain...yeah, Jack Teagarden was also there. Yes, he was there that morning, too. He was on the stand playing.

ctx.x: Yeah, they used to have breakfast dances there. They would start at twelve o'clock Sunday night, and they'd run all night long, until the last couple go out, which was six-seven o'clock in the morning sometimes.

Anyway, Louis made his appearance at the Savoy, which was one block down the street from this place. And after he finished at the Savoy, everybody went... Not everybody, because everybody couldn't get in that little club. They went to... The musicians went to the Lenox Club, to sit and jam and one-thing-and-another. And Rex Stewart happened to be there, and oh, he was blowin' his head off. I think, I'm not certain...yeah, Jack Teagarden was also there. Yes, he was there that morning, too. He was on the stand…
